run_finetuning_whisper: run fine-tuning of a Flax Whisper model for sequence-to-sequence speech recognition on a dataset
create_data_collator_speech: create a data collator that dynamically pads speech inputs and text labels for Flax Whisper training
compute_wer_metrics: compute word error rate metrics on model predictions and reference transcriptions with normalization
